recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-14705 unless a future work group decision reopens broader CodeSystem supplement guidance under a later issue.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification STU3 vocab issue asking to fix CodeSystem.supplements definition and comment wording: use reference-style wording rather than "Defines", use singular "supplement", and correct "too" to "to".
initial_application: The issue was applied in git-svn commit 080e47c1a0 (svn r13341), a CodeSystem documentation batch explicitly listing GF#14705. That commit changed the then-authoritative spreadsheet definition from "Defines the code system that this code system supplement is adding designations and properties too" to "References the code system that this code system supplement is adding designations and properties to" and changed the comment to singular "a code system supplement" language.
additional_context: CodeSystem is active in the current build according to source/fhir.ini. The current source has since been refactored into source/codesystem/structuredefinition-CodeSystem.xml and now phrases the element as the canonical URL of the supplemented code system. Jira search found other CodeSystem supplement issues, but they concern distinct supplement behavior or guidance and do not contradict this wording cleanup. Zulip and Confluence searches found no FHIR-14705-specific conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current authoritative source already removes the old "Defines" wording, uses singular supplement language in the comment, and fixes "too" to "to". The only matching diagram title also says "References ... to" and is not an authoritative source needing edits.
